newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Dunham-Bush Malaysia plans bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Dunham-Bush Malaysia plans bonus issue.

text.p: Dunham-Bush (Malaysia) Bhd has proposed a one-for-one bonus issue of up to 68.6 million shares and a transfer of listing to the main board from the second board of the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
In a statement, it said the proposed bonus issue would increase its issued and paid-up capital to a level commensurate with the group's current scale of operations.
The capital increase was also to fulfill one of the requirements for the transfer of the company to the main board, it said.
The paid-up capital of Dunham-Bush, which sells air-conditioning and refrigeration equipment, will increase to 137.99 million ringgit after the bonus issue.
The proposals are subject to approvals of the Securities Commission, the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange and shareholders, the statement said.
